name: The Challenge
notes: From The Challenge 2026.gpx. Starts at Golden Pools, finishes in the east (same finish as the other races).

name: The Mutarazi Traverse
notes: From The Mutarazi Traverse 2026.gpx. Loop from the southern start past Mutarazi Falls to the Ringing Rocks and back.

name: The Ultra
notes: From Ultra 2026.gpx. Starts in the south, north to Golden Pools, then the Challenge route to the finish. The file's water points and stations are the checkpoints.

name: Back2Back
notes: From Back2Back 2026.gpx, which holds two routes: the Mutarazi Traverse loop, then the Challenge. Day order taken from the file.

name: The Epic
notes: From The Epic 2026.gpx. Same start as the Ultra, with a long loop west through the national park before Golden Pools.
